title: Olimpia Splendid Aquaria 12L and 24L Dehumidifier – 2025 – National Product Review
description:
Cope with Australia's hot and humid climate with the Olimpia Splendid Aquaria Dehumidifiers. These Italian-designed powerhouse units can extract up to 24 litres of moisture daily from spaces up to 100m³, ensuring your home remains comfortable. The filtration systems, featuring an antidust and integrated carbon filter, not only removes excess humidity but also purifies your air by capturing allergens and eliminating odours. Enjoy ultimate convenience with digital controls offering three-speed settings, a 24-hour timer, a full tank alarm, and a clear temperature and humidity indicator, all easily transportable on castor wheels.
